src = open('/app/submission/planner.py').read()

# --- adaptive time limit in _safe_linprog ---
old = '''def _safe_linprog(c, a_ub, b_ub, a_eq, b_eq, bounds, method, options):
    opts = dict(options)
    opts.setdefault("primal_feasibility_tolerance", 1e-9)
    opts.setdefault("dual_feasibility_tolerance", 1e-9)
    opts.setdefault("time_limit", 20.0)
    try:
        return linprog(c, A_ub=a_ub, b_ub=b_ub, A_eq=a_eq, b_eq=b_eq,
                       bounds=bounds, method=method, options=opts)
    except Exception:
        return None'''
new = '''def _safe_linprog(c, a_ub, b_ub, a_eq, b_eq, bounds, method, options):
    opts = dict(options)
    opts.setdefault("primal_feasibility_tolerance", 1e-9)
    opts.setdefault("dual_feasibility_tolerance", 1e-9)
    limit = _remaining_time() - 1.0
    if limit < 1.0:
        return None
    opts.setdefault("time_limit", min(20.0, limit))
    try:
        return linprog(c, A_ub=a_ub, b_ub=b_ub, A_eq=a_eq, b_eq=b_eq,
                       bounds=bounds, method=method, options=opts)
    except Exception:
        return None'''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)

# --- process level deadline bookkeeping ---
old2 = '''REQUEST_TIME_LIMIT = 60.0
'''
new2 = '''REQUEST_TIME_LIMIT = 60.0
PROCESS_TIME_LIMIT = 780.0   # stay well inside the 900s process budget

_STATE = {"start": None, "deadline": None}


def _reset_deadline():
    now = time.monotonic()
    if _STATE["start"] is None:
        _STATE["start"] = now
    remaining_process = PROCESS_TIME_LIMIT - (now - _STATE["start"])
    if remaining_process < 5.0:
        _STATE["deadline"] = now + 5.0
    else:
        _STATE["deadline"] = now + min(REQUEST_TIME_LIMIT, remaining_process)


def _remaining_time():
    dl = _STATE["deadline"]
    if dl is None:
        return REQUEST_TIME_LIMIT
    return dl - time.monotonic()

'''
assert old2 in src
src = src.replace(old2, new2)

# --- call _reset_deadline at the start of solve_request ---

'''
new3 = '''    prob = build_problem(req)
    prob["epoch"] = req["epoch"]
    _reset_deadline()
    deadline = _STATE["deadline"]
'''
assert old3 in src
src = src.replace(old3, new3)
open('/app/submission/planner.py','w').write(src)
print("patched")
